410.description: 媒体版权或版本已撤回

x-sunset.condition: 仅在 assetVersion/subject/tenant/channel/range/expiry/revocationVersion 绑定和回滚 Gate 通过后安排日期

post.x-migration: 旧 signed-url 请求迁移到统一的短时 access grant；URL 不进入 metadata、事件、日志、telemetry 或普通审计。

410.description: 媒体授权已撤回或过期

x-sunset.condition: 仅在客户端切换为范围绑定的短时 grant 且兼容回滚 Gate 通过后安排日期

get.x-migration: Gateway 不再代理媒体 bytes；客户端先取得范围绑定的短时 grant，再访问交付通道。

206.description: Range 元数据和短时内容引用

416.description: Range 越界或格式不支持

200.description: 媒体进度已写入 learning-service owner schema

get.x-migration: Historical B11 settings adapter; notification-service owns the single M1-016 preference fact at /api/v1/notifications/preferences.

put.x-migration: Historical B11 settings adapter; request fields are translated to the closed M1-016 subscription command and never create a second owner.

get.x-migration: Historical B11 message adapter; it must project only the M1-016 notification message schema.

post.x-migration: Historical B11 message read adapter; it records only a server-owned read fact.
Historical arbitrary-entity sync write; learning-service accepts only its own canonical facts through the M1-016 protocol and does not become a cross-domain writer.

get.x-migration: Historical generic sync response; only the learning-owned receipt projection is canonical in M1-016.
Historical client cursor adapter; cursor state is now a server-owned learning projection.

put.x-migration: Historical client-owned cursor write; clients cannot advance a server-owned cursor in M1-016.

get.x-migration: Historical generic conflict adapter; conflict facts are exposed only through the learning-owned M1-016 projection.

post.x-migration: Historical generic conflict recovery adapter; only the M1-016 closed KEEP_SERVER_FACT/DISCARD_LOCAL_DRAFT/RETRY_CANONICAL_COMMAND actions are allowed.

x-contract.clientAuthority: NONE; receipt, owner, tenant and server version are server-derived

x-authorization.clientAuthority: NONE for receipt identity, server version or owner

get.x-migration: Canonical M1-016 learning-owned read projection; the arbitrary-entity B11 sync write/list adapter is historical.

200.description: learning-service 拥有的同步命令回执

x-contract.clientAuthority: NONE; cursor and version are server-derived

x-authorization.clientAuthority: NONE for cursor, owner or version

get.x-migration: Canonical M1-016 server-owned cursor read; the B11 client cursor PUT is deprecated and cannot advance this fact.

x-contract.clientAuthority: NONE; conflict, versions and owner are server-derived

x-authorization.clientAuthority: NONE for conflict identity, owner or server versions

get.x-migration: Canonical M1-016 conflict projection; the B11 generic conflict adapter is historical.

post.summary: Apply a bounded learning sync conflict recovery action

x-contract.clientAuthority: NONE; conflict state, server version and recovery receipt are server-derived

x-authorization.clientAuthority: NONE for owner, server facts, merge outcome or recovery receipt

post.x-migration: Canonical M1-016 bounded recovery; MERGE, REPLAY and MANUAL_RECOVERY actions are not accepted.

x-sunset.condition: 仅在录音专用 consent、intent/complete、owner PEP、删除与回滚 Gate 通过后安排日期

post.x-migration: 旧 metadata 登记不代表远端资产完成；canonical 流程由 media-service 创建本人绑定 intent 并可信校验。

x-sunset.condition: 仅在 assessment-owned attempt、可信结果、兼容读取与回滚 Gate 通过后安排日期

post.x-migration: 旧 learning write 只作兼容适配；canonical completion 由 assessment-service 拥有，learning 只消费可信结果。

200.description: 历史兼容请求由 assessment-service 适配为跟读 attempt；learning 仅消费可信结果。

B11Range.name: Range
B11Range.description: 只支持单一 bytes Range；越界返回 416。

B11Forbidden.description: 默认拒绝的租户、主体、版权或策略访问

B11NotFound.description: 不存在或对当前主体不可见

B11Conflict.description: 幂等、版本或冲突恢复拒绝

B11Error.description: Compatibility error payload for existing media and notification operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

checksumSha256.description: 只传校验摘要；媒体对象不在 API 响应中。

reference.description: 短时授权引用；不得写入日志或事件。

payloadHash.description: 只传 hash，不传离线原文。
